steps.subject: sky
steps.action: place a light touch of blue in the sky
steps.rule: transparent color sparkles over the liquid clear

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add crimson into the lower sky with light touches
steps.rule: let colors meet on their own instead of overblending

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: warm the sky with dark sienna
steps.rule: warm tones warm the sky up

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: mix blue and crimson for a sky tone
steps.load: blue and crimson mixed, more crimson
steps.rule: blue is much stronger so use more crimson

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: darken the top of the sky with the mix
steps.rule: variation keeps the sky from looking too light

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add opaque white touches to the sky
steps.rule: don't overwork so transparent areas stay

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap small tree shapes in the background
steps.rule: tapping upward keeps the bottoms darker

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: add more dark sienna for warmth
steps.rule: warmth keeps a winter scene from feeling too cold

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap mist at the base of the trees
steps.rule: mist only at the base, not up the trees

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: pull white snow across the base
steps.rule: pulled snow picks up tree color so it reads as shadow

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: add a bushy layer of trees with brown and sienna
steps.load: brown and sienna mixed on round
steps.rule: each layer adds depth and planes

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: lay snow under the trees
steps.rule: snow behind the trees creates separate planes

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: scrape twig marks into the snow with knife tip

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: pull dark color down into the snow edges
steps.load: white added, then dark pulled in
steps.rule: dark pulled into the snow makes recesses

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: paint thin brown trees with a liner
steps.rule: thinned paint keeps a sharp point

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add limbs to the thin trees

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: blend the tree base into the snow with fan
steps.load: liquid clear added to the brush

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: add a stone bump under the snow
steps.rule: liquid clear dries with a glazed sheen

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: scrape out a basic barn shape with the knife
steps.rule: scraping sets the perspective and removes extra paint

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: outline the barn in white
steps.rule: outlining first gives a smooth edge

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: add brown boards with the knife edge
steps.load: brown mix pulled flat, rolled on knife edge
steps.rule: white touches in the overhang read as boards

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: add white shed roof

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: pull a snow bank along the barn base
steps.load: sienna and white mixed, rolled on knife

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: add weathered board marks and darken one side
steps.rule: the barn is old and worn from winter

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: paint a door in the barn
steps.rule: a door gives a way in

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: firm up door edges with white and dark

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: pull snow down with clear and white on fan
steps.load: clear and white loaded full on fan
steps.rule: picking up dark gives the shadow side

steps.subject: fence
steps.action: paint a distant fence with thinned brown
steps.rule: rails get smaller to show distance

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: paint dead bushes poking through the snow

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: blend grass bottoms with clear and white
steps.rule: blending ties the grass into the scene

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: paint a small tree on the left with brown

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add arms to the closer tree
steps.rule: birds need places to perch

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: drop in a big tree with brown

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint birch limbs with thin brown
steps.rule: limbs crossing the trunk add dimension

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add small dabs in the middle

steps.subject: other: signature
steps.action: sign the painting with red
